name: Feather Family [Sunbird]
desc:
🕊️ Bird Roleplay 🕊️
Explore the world as one of many types of birds! Choose your species, customize yourself, hatch from an egg, grow up, build your own nest, and join flocks!

Next Update: Friday, October 16th
- Vulture species skin

🐣 Latest Update: Burrowing Owl
- Added Burrowing Owl skin
- Added new ability 'Night Vision' where brighter vision can be toggled on and off in actions. Owls, Nightjars, and Peryton now have night vision ability
- Added Halloween decorations in Village
- Roleplay server hosts will have an 💬 icon next to their username if they can chat with you
- Remodeled heads of adult Great Horned Owl and Barn Owl
- Several small changes and bug fixes

The 2026 QnA has been posted in the community announcement!
